div.div:
Event-specific free/paid product; type remains paid even if discounted to zero.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
event_id: uuid [FK NN]
name: text [NN]
description: text [NN]
kind: text [NN]
price_minor: bigint [NN]
quantity_limit: integer [NN]
per_order_limit: integer [NN]
sales_open_at: timestamptz [NN]
sales_close_at: timestamptz [NN]
is_hidden: boolean [NN]
default false
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (id, event_id)
CK1: kind IN ('free','paid')
CK2: (kind = 'free' AND price_minor = 0) OR (kind = 'paid' AND price_minor > 0)
CK3: quantity_limit >= 0 AND per_order_limit > 0
CK4: sales_close_at > sales_open_at
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(event_id) -> event(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
Seat copied into one event and mapped to an event ticket type.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
event_id: uuid [FK NN]
layout_id: uuid [FK NN]
venue_seat_id: uuid [FK NN]
ticket_type_id: uuid [FK NN]
section_label: text [NN]
row_label: text [NN]
seat_label: text [NN]
is_blocked: boolean [NN]
default false
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (event_id, venue_seat_id)
UQ2: (event_id, section_label, row_label, seat_label)
UQ3: (id, event_id, ticket_type_id)
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(event_id, layout_id) -> event(id, venue_layout_id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
(venue_seat_id, layout_id) -> venue_seat(id, layout_id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
(ticket_type_id, event_id) -> ticket_type(id, event_id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
Authenticated basket reservation; one event and buyer per hold.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
event_id: uuid [FK NN]
buyer_user_id: uuid [FK NN]
status: text [NN]
default 'active'
expires_at: timestamptz [NN]
closed_at: timestamptz [?]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (id, event_id)
UQ2: (id, event_id, buyer_user_id)
CK1: status IN ('active','consumed','expired','released')
CK2: expires_at > created_at
CK3: (status = 'active') = (closed_at IS NULL)
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(event_id) -> event(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
(buyer_user_id) -> app_user(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
One row per admission unit; preserve allocation history after release.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
event_id: uuid [FK NN]
hold_id: uuid [FK NN]
ticket_type_id: uuid [FK NN]
event_seat_id: uuid [FK ?]
state: text [NN]
default 'held'
released_at: timestamptz [?]
release_reason: text [?]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (id, event_id, hold_id, ticket_type_id)
CK1: state IN ('held','sold','refund_quarantine','released')
CK2: (state = 'released') = (released_at IS NOT NULL)
CK3: (state = 'released') = (release_reason IS NOT NULL)
CK4: release_reason IS NULL OR release_reason IN
('expired','abandoned','free_cancel','refund_succeeded')
PARTIAL UQ: (event_seat_id) WHERE event_seat_id IS NOT NULL AND state IN
('held','sold','refund_quarantine')
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(hold_id, event_id) -> checkout_hold(id, event_id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
(ticket_type_id, event_id) -> ticket_type(id, event_id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
(event_seat_id, event_id, ticket_type_id) -> event_seat(id, event_id, ticket_type_id)
[0..1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.
